_approach: Ragga rewind: bar 1 keeps the dancehall 3-3-2 kick with rimshot answers and a tom pickup; bar 2 is the reload moment - the kick drops out and rim/tom hits trade an accelerating call-and-response (8ths -> 16ths -> near-32nds) while everything falls silent for the last two steps, the classic 'hold it... rewind' pause before the selector drops it again. Ref: ragga jungle's rewind-and-reload culture (Shy FX/Remarc lineage), UKF's Tim Reaper interview on break selection under MC calls. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
